disabled.title: This feature is turned off
disabled.body: Turn it back on in Settings to use this window again.

error.disabled: {name} is turned off. Turn it on in Settings → Features.
error.localOnly: This can only be done on the host itself, not from a remote desktop.

reason.module_off: Off while its module is off. Turning the module back on restores it.

settings.title: Features
settings.help: Turn off what you don't use. A feature that is off stops completely (no menu entry, no background work); its data is kept.
settings.remoteReadOnly: Feature switches can only be changed on the host itself, not from a remote desktop.
settings.resetMessage:
Every switch goes back to its fresh-install value. These will be turned off:
{list}
settings.resetNothingOff: Every switch goes back to its fresh-install value. Nothing that is on now will be turned off.

skills_global.title: Turn on global skills?
skills_global.message:
The Skills Allocation tab gets a Global column. A skill switched on there is linked into ~/.claude/skills (Claude) or ~/.agents/skills (Codex), so every project sees it, including Claude Code and Codex run outside Puppeteer.
Skills you keep there yourself are never replaced or deleted; a name already taken is reported instead.
